items.repository_truth: Access is now proven; the repository is intentionally greenfield.
items.resolution: Close the access gate without claiming application conformance.

items.reference_claim: Python/SQL modular monolith is the reference path
items.repository_truth: No application runtime, package, schema, or module existed.
items.resolution: Adopt Python 3.12 as a reversible control-plane baseline; retain the architecture as a preference pending measured replacement evidence.

items.reference_claim: PostgreSQL/PostGIS, DuckDB/Parquet, object storage, lineage, and provider interfaces are reference components
items.repository_truth: Only unmanaged local PostgreSQL is detected; PostGIS and DuckDB are absent and no project configuration exists.
items.resolution: Treat every component as an unverified downstream task, not installed capability.

items.repository_truth: The recovered Project OS campaign passes, while application code and empirical evidence did not exist.
items.resolution: Preserve the 10/10 design/evaluator-readiness axis and keep real evidence maturity unproven.

items.reference_claim: A sealed and external evaluator topology is required
items.repository_truth: No independent custodian, external evaluator repository, CI status publisher, or hidden holdout resource is evidenced.
items.resolution: Install only the public evaluator locally and open separate sealed-custody and hidden-holdout gates.
